name: B10-0445/2025 – § 38 – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 38.Underlines the need to support a competitive industry, economic growth and standards of living by not imposing an additional intermediary climate target for the EU; recalls the progress already made by EU Member States and the importance of preserving our industry to enable future investments and innovations, as maintaining strong and independent industrial capacities is essential for the EU’s strategic autonomy and resilience; calls on the Commission to urgently review Regulation (EU) 2019/631 in order to revoke the 2035 ban on combustion engine vehicles; recalls the importance of technological neutrality in reducing CO₂ emissions;
